job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
- Maintain and enhance existing software components to improve performance and reliability.
- Document development processes and solutions to facilitate knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
- Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing best practices.




Preferred candidate profile

Strong experience in SAP FI S/4HANA and core financial processes.
Knowledge of Universal Journal, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, and Financial Reporting.
Experience integrating SAP FI with CO, MM, and SD.
Hands-on experience with AI copilots, LLM-based assistants, AI-driven testing, and automated documentation.
Understanding of responsible AI usage and pre-built AI services.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Expected Outcomes



Deliver efficient and reliable SAP FI solutions using AI-enabled productivity.
Improve financial accuracy, process efficiency, and transparency.
Bridge business, SAP functional, technical, and AI teams.
